source.title: Vision-Language Models Create Cross-Modal Task Representations
source.authors: Grace Luo; Trevor Darrell; Amir Bar

record.tranche_reason: Tests whether task representations transfer across modalities and related models using activation patching and cosine similarity, rather than testing scale-dependent convergence with the original claim's distance-based approach.
record.gate_note: The study tests useful transfer of task vectors, not convergence as models scale or alignment between independently trained vision and language models on paired image-caption data. It does not vary similarity measures. The task-overriding results concern induced task following, not representation convergence, and are not included as rows.
record.test_reason: Only the LLM-to-VLM experiment (Sec. 4.2, Tables 3 and 11) compares two models. It shows task vectors from a base LLM (Vicuna, Mistral) can be patched unchanged, an identity map, into its own fine-tuned VLM (LLaVA-v1.5, Idefics2) with no accuracy loss. This bears narrowly on V4, for a parent model and its fine-tuned descendant that were not trained independently. All other results compare modalities within a single VLM, not across models.
record.authors_conclusion: Largely correct. The authors conclude VLMs map text examples, image examples and instructions into a shared task-vector space. They report that patching beats cross-modal few-shot prompting. They also find base-LLM task vectors transfer to the fine-tuned VLM, which they read as 'somewhat retained' representations and possible re-use of language-learned functions. They state they lack an explanation for why the shared representations arise.
record.recipe_differences: Uses task-vector extraction and activation patching, plus cosine similarity and t-SNE, rather than measuring model-to-model convergence in the scale-dependent distance geometry described by the claim.
record.method_sensitivity: Transfer accuracy varies with specification-query modality and direction; the paper also reports results across different tasks, VLMs, and datasets.

fits_no_version.finding: Within a single VLM, task vectors from text examples, image examples and instructions cluster by task rather than modality. Patching transfers across modalities, with text-to-image beating image-to-image but image-to-text trailing text-to-text. Text and image ICL also pass through shared input/task/answer layer phases.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Within one multimodal model, different-modality specifications of the same task converge to a shared task representation in middle layers.

record.peer_reviewed: International Conference on Machine Learning; PMLR 267 (2025)
record.problems: The transfer tests cover three VLMs, six main tasks, and selected extended VQA tasks. Accuracy is incomplete, the LLM-to-VLM comparisons use corresponding model families, and the text does not report uncertainty for the Table 3, Table 4, or Table 12 values.
record.rows_left_out: Per-task results from Tables 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, and 12 were not extracted where the flattened text did not reliably assign each number to its method and task. The six-task aggregates and clearly stated text results are retained. The paper's other experiments do not directly test V4 transfer or interchangeability.

untested.parts: No scale or capability sweep; no independently trained models compared.
No separate vision and language models on paired image-caption data; no variation in model quality.
Only identity patching between a base LLM and its own fine-tuned VLM. No independently trained pairs, learned linear maps, stitching, relative representations, or unpaired mapping.
No recurring neurons, SAE features or circuits across models.
No variation of similarity metric or out-of-distribution inputs. The layer is chosen on validation, but cross-model sensitivity to layer is not reported.
No plateau analysis or test of shared-data explanations; the shared-initialization cause is built into the design, not tested.

missing.what: Per-task LLM-to-VLM transfer. Idefics2 is mixed: Country-Currency rises 0.40 to 0.58, while Animal-Young (0.62 to 0.55) and Country-Capital (0.61 to 0.57) fall. LLaVA's Animal-Young rises 0.18 to 0.33.

record.verdict_notes: The record's V4 linkage of within-model modality rows is wrong: V4 concerns mapping between models, so those rows are moved to fits_no_version. The only cross-model evidence is a parent LLM and its fine-tuned VLM sharing initialization, which is a weak test of interchangeability between independently trained models. Tranche changed from T2 to T3.

versions.untested_parts: No model size, capability, or scale sweep; no comparison of independently trained models with different architectures, objectives, or data.

The study transfers task vectors between text and image specifications within VLM tasks, not representations of paired images and captions across vision and language models; it does not vary model performance.
No comparison across random initialization seeds or analysis of shared features or subspaces across same-architecture networks.

Tests activation patching of task vectors across modalities and from corresponding base LLMs to VLMs. Does not test linear maps, stitching layers, relative representations, arbitrary model pairs, or transfer without paired task specifications.
No analysis of recurring interpretable neurons, SAE features, or circuits.
Does not compare similarity metrics or their settings, or test convergence on alternative or out-of-distribution input sets.
Does not test whether alignment plateaus or whether shared data or objectives explain it.

relationships.condition: Task vectors patched by identity from base LLM (Vicuna, Mistral) into its own fine-tuned VLM (LLaVA-v1.5, Idefics2), six tasks
relationships.reason: Cosine 0.95/0.89 vs 0.58 mismatched; LLM-VLM patch accuracy 0.37/0.52 matches or exceeds VLM-VLM 0.32/0.51 (r1-r3, r5-r8).
relationships.display_finding: Task-vector cosine similarities were 0.95/0.89 versus 0.58 for mismatched vectors, and LLM-to-VLM patch accuracies of 0.37/0.52 matched or exceeded VLM-to-VLM accuracies of 0.32/0.51.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.

reader_labels.label: supports
reader_labels.condition: Task-vector transfer from each base LLM to its corresponding VLM
reader_labels.reason: The paired task vectors have cosine similarities of 0.95 and 0.89 versus the 0.58 random reference, and LLM-to-VLM patching produces test accuracy of 0.37 and 0.52 (r1-r3, r6, r8).

reader_labels.label: limits_scope
reader_labels.condition: Task-vector transfer across modality directions and task sets
reader_labels.reason: Transfer accuracy is incomplete and varies by direction: image-to-text patching trails text-to-text patching in Mantis-Fuyu and Idefics2, while text-to-image patching is stronger in the reported averages; the extended VQA patching average is 0.69 (r9-r23).

reader_labels.label: limits_scope
reader_labels.condition: Text-example patching across the three VLMs on the six main tasks
reader_labels.reason: Patching improves on prompting and unimodal baselines, but the reported gains do not establish near-lossless interchangeability (r24-r25).
